prompts.tdNature: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for a Chromebook map game. ONE atlas, EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 isolated sprites, evenly spaced square cells, no grid/labels/text. Light upper left. NO cast shadows or ground platforms. CAMERA STRICTLY CONSISTENT: orthographic TOP-DOWN THREE-QUARTER, looking north down at 60 degrees, azimuth ZERO. All sprites centered in equal cells, entire object visible, transparent margins at least 14% of cell. Row2: (5) patch of five simple pink/yellow flowers (6) three coral red white-spotted mushrooms (7) square golden orange wooden crate with cross braces, front and top visible, zero side visible (8) wooden orange barrel with navy metal hoops. Row3: (9) coral flag on cream pole, teal round foot (10) navy streetlamp with golden lantern (11) round two-tier stone fountain, vivid cyan water, horizontal concentric ellipse basins (12) terracotta flowerpot with pink blooms and emerald leaves. Same outlined cartoon style for ALL twelve. Not a scene, no horizon, no extra items. Real alpha transparent background. Output square canvas with 4x3 uniform cells occupying full canvas; preserve empty margins.
